noise.unsupported_fact: New information asserted as fact without source support; an explicitly marked new suggestion is not automatically a factual claim.
noise.source_distortion: A factual assertion contradicts or alters the retained source meaning, temporal order, actor, certainty, or performed-vs-proposed status.
noise.format_drift: Declared edit contract/schema/allowed fields/op scope or native protocol boundary violated. Format validity alone does not imply fidelity.

annotation_requirements: claim spans and source evidence with rationale

task_criteria.decision_continuation: Preserve constraints and failed/untried distinction, choose supported next action.
task_criteria.cross_level_traceability: Actually traverse every required hierarchy link and recover original detail; representation alone not success.
task_criteria.collaboration: Peer actually executes authorized work and next parent/peer request uses evidence; suggestion alone not success.
task_criteria.resource_tradeoff: Report measured time/cost/quality independently; unknown resources are not free.

unknown_policy: Missing annotations, missing outputs or judge errors remain unknown/not_evaluated. Fixture output never gains a model quality score.
